target.build: default Go build; Go runtime slice-bounds check is the oracle

trigger.message: PFCP Heartbeat Request with sequence-number / header trailing bytes mutated to oversized values (0xFFFF...)
trigger.ie_path: PFCP header (Sequence Number + spare) propagating into IE region boundary calculation
trigger.field: Manipulated header bytes confuse ParseMultiIEs about where the IE region ends; (*IE).UnmarshalBinary then attempts a slice with start > end (panic 'slice bounds out of range [6:4]'). PA1 'Malformed Field' on length-related fields.

ground_truth.crash_type: panic: runtime error: slice bounds out of range [6:4]

root_cause.note: Mutated header bytes flow into ParseMultiIEs's slice-length math; the IE dispatcher then computes an invalid sub-slice. Crash frame explicit in issue body's panic stack (unlike FREE5GC-PFCP-004).
